packages.name: @humanfs/node
packages.mitigation: The package is absent from the production API artifact and is executed only by the repository lint toolchain.
packages.revisit: Recheck the classification when ESLint changes its filesystem implementation or the production artifact boundary changes.

packages.name: baseline-browser-mapping
packages.mitigation: Next 16.4.3 declares baseline-browser-mapping ^2.9.19, so 2.11.0 or newer resolves through its supported dependency graph without a repository override.
packages.revisit: Recheck the browser target graph when Next changes its baseline-browser-mapping dependency or the Web build target policy changes.

packages.name: brace-expansion
packages.parent: minimatch via ESLint/Nest CLI/@swc/cli/Sentry bundler plugins

packages.name: deepmerge
packages.mitigation: GHSA-gcqx-w48m-w2h4 (low) has no patched release. Nest CLI 12 made fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin an optional webpack-only peer, and the API builds with SWC, so the dev lockfile no longer resolves deepmerge; the alert stays open on main until that lockfile is promoted. On main, fork-ts-checker-webpack-plugin merges only its own build options with deepmerge during Nest CLI builds, receives no request input, and @nestjs/cli is absent from the production API artifact.
packages.revisit: After the next dev to main promotion, confirm the alert closed on main and remove this entry. Review by 2026-11-29 if the promotion has not happened.

packages.name: js-yaml
packages.mitigation: ESLint and Nest CLI parents both accept JS-YAML 4.3.2 through their declared ranges, so the patched version resolves naturally without a root override.
packages.revisit: Recheck the graph when @eslint/eslintrc, cosmiconfig, ESLint, or Nest CLI changes its JS-YAML ownership.

packages.name: multer
packages.mitigation: NestJS 12.3.2 pins patched Multer 2.5.0 in @nestjs/platform-express, so the patched version resolves without a repository selector or a direct upload dependency.
packages.revisit: Recheck when @nestjs/platform-express changes its Multer pin, or when the application adopts a direct multipart caller.

packages.name: mysql2
packages.mitigation: Prisma 7.10.1 declares mysql2 3.24.4 exactly, so the patched driver resolves in the shipped Prisma CLI graph without a repository override, while application database calls use PostgreSQL through pg and @prisma/adapter-pg.
packages.revisit: Recheck when Prisma changes its mysql2 dependency, or when a verified production deploy excludes the Prisma CLI graph.

packages.name: next
packages.mitigation: The Web runtime is on the supported Next 16.4.3 patch (16.4.1 or newer fixes both critical advisories) and verifies the standalone build plus browser surfaces rather than suppressing either advisory.
packages.revisit: Recheck Next security advisories on every supported-line migration and before a production release.

packages.name: postcss
packages.mitigation: The root override keeps PostCSS at or above the patched 8.5.28 (Renovate raises its value) while Next still pins 8.5.23 exactly.
packages.revisit: Remove the override when Next, Tailwind, Sentry, Storybook, and Vite all resolve PostCSS 8.5.28 or newer without it and their closest build regressions pass.

packages.name: qs
packages.mitigation: The compatible patched release is resolved through the existing Express and body-parser ranges without changing the public HTTP contract.
packages.revisit: Recheck legitimate query and form parsing behavior whenever the Express HTTP adapter or parser configuration changes.

packages.name: sharp
packages.mitigation: Next 16.4.3 declares Sharp ^0.35.5 as an optional dependency, so the patched release resolves without a root override and the Web standalone artifact plus next/image callers are verified.
packages.revisit: Recheck the image optimizer graph when Next or the production image handling policy changes.

packages.name: source-map-js
packages.parent: PostCSS via Next/Webpack and magicast via Prisma config

packages.name: ws
packages.mitigation: engine.io 6.6.11 and socket.io-adapter 2.5.8 declare ws ~8.21.0, so the patched 8.21.3 resolves through their ranges without a repository override.
packages.revisit: Recheck when engine.io, socket.io-adapter, or Storybook changes its ws range; realtime plus Storybook regressions cover both paths.
